company: Wayve
title: Engineering Manager, SRE – AV Fleet, Japan
location: Japan
field: -
description:
Set technical direction for observability, SLI/SLOs, production readiness, release safety, automation, remote diagnostics and fleet tooling; participate directly in design and code reviews and challenge failure assumptions.
Build scalable tooling and automation Guide the design and delivery of tools, services and APIs that improve fleet visibility, health monitoring, remote diagnosis, configuration, release safety and operational control.
Willingness to work regularly onsite in the Yokohama area and join an engineering escalation rotation.
This position is based in Japan and is not fully remote.
The role requires regular presence with the team and fleet, occasional work outside standard office hours for critical operational events, and domestic or international travel as programme needs require.
This is a full-time role based in our office in Yokohama, Japan.
At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home.
